karty.mnemo: Your BODY (BOdd-i) sinks under the water: drowning.

karty.priklad: Dyn ni'n cyfnewid anrhegion adeg y Nadolig.
karty.mnemo: cyf- (each other) + newid (to change): changing with each other = exchanging.

extra.pozn: own example (the sentence on p. 73 is a self-assessment box)

karty.priklad_cs: We must plan the meeting (cynllunio → [g]ynllunio after i).

karty.priklad: Wnest ti lwyddo i berswadio rhywun? – Do, o'r diwedd!
karty.priklad_cs: Did you manage to persuade someone? – Yes, at last! (llwyddo → [l]wyddo after wnest ti; perswadio → [b]erswadio after i)

extra.pozn: llwyddo i + verb, soft mutation after i; own example

karty.cs: to adopt; to take on, to accept
karty.priklad: Mae hi wedi mabwysiadu babi chwe mis oed.
karty.priklad_cs: She has adopted a six-month-old baby.
karty.mnemo: mab = son: to take someone as your son.

karty.priklad: Rhaid i ni farchnata'r ŵyl yn well.
karty.priklad_cs: We must market the festival better (marchnata → [f]archnata after i).
karty.mnemo: marchnad = market: getting something onto the market.

karty.priklad: Mae'r daith yn para hanner awr.
karty.priklad_cs: The journey lasts half an hour.
karty.mnemo: A PARAchute (PARA) ride lasts a good half hour all the way down.

karty.priklad: Rhaid i ni berswadio pobl i ddod.
karty.priklad_cs: We must persuade people to come (perswadio → [b]erswadio after i; dod → [dd]od after i).

karty.mnemo: 'UM… DEAR, I'D (ym-DDIR-ied) trust him with my life!'

extra.pozn: pattern ymddiried yn + personal forms of yn: ynddo i, ynddot ti, ynddo fe, ynddi hi, ynddon ni, ynddoch chi, ynddyn nhw (before a noun yn → nasal mutation)

karty.priklad: Nodwch o leia chwe lle twristaidd yng Nghymru.
karty.priklad_cs: Name at least six tourist places in Wales (Cymru → [Ngh]ymru after yn).

karty.priklad: Collodd Tom ei ddannedd gosod yn y môr.
karty.priklad_cs: Tom lost his false teeth in the sea (dannedd → [dd]annedd after ei = his).
karty.mnemo: gosod = to put in, to fit: teeth that are fitted in.

extra.pozn: in the coursebook in the arall box; a plural-only noun, no gender given

karty.priklad: Dewch draw aton ni ar ôl i chi ddod adre!
karty.priklad_cs: Come over to ours when you get home! (dod → [dd]od after i chi)
karty.mnemo: draw = over there (as in pen draw): come over from over there.

karty.priklad: Druan â ti – mae llawer o waith gyda ti yn cynllunio'r cyfarfod!
karty.priklad_cs: You poor thing – you've got loads of work planning the meeting!
karty.mnemo: DRUAN sounds like DREARY ONE: the poor thing whose day is dreary from start to finish.

extra.pozn: druan ag e, druan â hi, druan â chi

sever.priklad: Druan â ti – mae gen ti lawer o waith yn cynllunio'r cyfarfod!
sever.priklad_cs: You poor thing – you've got loads of work planning the meeting! (llawer → [l]awer after gen ti)
sever.pozn: north: mae gen ti instead of mae … gyda ti (L6)

karty.cs: to check, to look over (a text)
karty.cs_upresneni: to check a text, not to jump over something
karty.priklad: Wnei di edrych dros y neges yma? – Edrycha i drosti hi mewn munud.
karty.priklad_cs: Will you look over this message? – I'll look over it in a minute.
karty.mnemo: edrych (to look) + dros (over) = to look over, exactly like English.

extra.pozn: dros + soft mutation; personal forms: drosto i, drostot ti, drosto fe, drosti hi, droston ni, drostoch chi, drostyn nhw

karty.priklad: Dw i'n hoffi cerdded gyda'r hwyr.
karty.priklad_cs: I like walking in the evening.
karty.mnemo: hwyr = late: at the late hour of the day.

karty.priklad: Daeth pawb, gan gynnwys y plant.
karty.mnemo: cynnwys = to include; after gan it softens to gynnwys.

karty.slovo: Am beth dych chi eisiau siarad?
karty.cs: What do you want to talk about?
karty.priklad: Croeso i'r rhaglen! Am beth dych chi eisiau siarad heddiw?
karty.priklad_cs: Welcome to the programme! What do you want to talk about today?

sever.slovo: Am be dach chi isio siarad?
sever.priklad: Croeso i'r rhaglen! Am be dach chi isio siarad heddiw?
sever.priklad_cs: Welcome to the programme! What do you want to talk about today?

karty.priklad: Wyt ti wedi cwrdd â rhywun enwog? – Nac ydw, neb eto.
karty.priklad_cs: Have you met anyone famous? – No, no one yet.

extra.pozn: Robin Radio, Uned 6; question modelled on Cyfieithwch p. 73; a wedi question is answered Ydw / Nac ydw

sever.priklad: Wyt ti wedi cyfarfod â rhywun enwog? – Nac ydw, neb eto.
sever.priklad_cs: Have you met anyone famous? – No, no one yet.
sever.pozn: north: cyfarfod instead of cwrdd (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Dw i'n byw yma ers blynyddoedd.
karty.mnemo: ers = since, for + blynyddoedd (years, plural of blwyddyn).

extra.pozn: Robin Radio, Uned 6; ers + present tense = still going on
